name: Xichang LC-3
best_known_for: First operational CZ-3 launch pad — DFH-2 first comsat, retired CZ-3 missions
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). XSC LC-3 hosted the maiden Long March 3 flight in 1984 (first Chinese GTO success) and many subsequent Apstar / Asiasat / Sinosat missions.
